review_candidates.title: Solution Specialist
review_candidates.description: Description Our Why Datacom works with organisations and communities across Australia and New Zealand to make a difference in people’s lives and help organisations use the power of tech to innovate and grow. About The Role (your Why) As a Solution Specialist, you will be a key member of our Information Management and Productivity Solutions team working alongside customers to co-create solutions that transform and modernise the way they work. You will design, build, implement and support Microsoft 365 solutions that strengthen collaboration, information management and productivity, using SharePoint Online, Power Apps and Power Automate alongside Microsoft Teams, OneDrive and Microsoft Purview. You will also help customers realise the value of Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI by supporting practical use-case discovery, readiness reviews and adoption alongside senior specialists. You will apply responsible AI practices in your own work and build your capability through hands-on learning, demonstrations and contributions to basic Copilot Studio agent configuration, testing and documentation under guidance. You will deliver a first-class experience for customers of our Intelligent Workplace services. Using a consultative and co-design approach, you will explore customer needs and translate requirements into practical solutions. You will work autonomously on agreed project tasks within a collaborative team, following delivery methodologies, architectural standards and change-management processes, with senior specialists available for guidance and peer review. This role is part of our Australia and New Zealand team. We like to bring people together in person when we can, but we are mindful of the benefits of working from home for work/ life balance. We therefore leave it to you and the team you join to figure out what works best! As we are an Australia & New Zealand team, for this role will be seeking applications from Australian geographies only. Please note that due to customer requirements, this role requires Australian Citizenship and eligibility to undertake a Federal Government NV1 Security Clearance ** What You'll Do As a Solution Specialist - M365 you will be focused on: Working with customers to understand their needs, translate business requirements and co-design practical Microsoft 365 solutions. Preparing and delivering customer presentations, product demonstrations and workshops that explain solutions clearly and build confidence. Designing, configuring, building and deploying solutions using SharePoint Online, Power Apps and Power Automate, with Microsoft Teams, OneDrive and Microsoft Purview. Delivering agreed project tasks using our delivery methodology, managing your work to meet scope, budgets, schedules and deliverables. Producing and maintaining solution designs, configuration guides, recommendation reports and accurate systems as-built documentation. Supporting architectural governance, peer reviews and risk assessment, and following agreed technical standards and change-management processes. Providing responsive ongoing support within agreed service levels, monitoring performance, resolving issues and documenting incidents and resolutions. Designing and supporting information management practices, including metadata, classification, document control, records management, retention and disposal, data loss prevention and access control. Contributing to migration and modernisation activities, using tools such as ShareGate and AvePoint where appropriate to the solution. Supporting Microsoft 365 Copilot use-case discovery and readiness reviews alongside senior specialists, including content quality, permissions, information protection and governance. Assisting with Copilot demonstrations, workshops and training so customers can use AI effectively, securely and responsibly in their day-to-day work. Contributing to basic Copilot Studio agent configuration, testing and documentation under guidance, as you develop your agent-building skills. Building customer capability through demonstrations, training materials, training and knowledge transfer. Providing accurate scope and effort estimates for proposals and supporting presales activities. Reporting progress in a timely manner, escalating issues and risks, and following recognised service-management and change/release processes. Sharing knowledge with colleagues and identifying practical opportunities for automation and AI that improve customer outcomes. Supporting occasional after-hours project or operational work when required. We are a pretty agile company, and are keen to respond to customer, technology and internal stakeholders’ changing requirements and this can mean we evolve in our roles to meet those needs. What you’ll bring: Required experience: 2–5 years of relevant technical experience in a commercial environment, with the ability to work autonomously within a team. Strong hands-on knowledge of core Microsoft 365 services, including SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive and Microsoft Purview. Experience designing, building and implementing solutions using Power Apps and Power Automate. Proficiency with PowerShell scripting for administration and automation. A solid working knowledge of information management principles, including metadata, classification, records management, retention, information protection and access control. Proven ability to produce clear solution designs, configuration guides and as-built documentation. Strong business awareness and the ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions. Strong problem-solving skills, customer empathy and a commitment to responsive support and effective issue resolution. Clear written and verbal communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills. Good time and priority management, with a track record of delivering agreed work within budgets and schedules. Familiarity with and hands-on use of Microsoft 365 Copilot for common productivity use cases, with a willingness to keep learning as the technology evolves. Understanding of safe prompting, validation of AI-generated outputs and responsible AI use, including permissions, sensitive information and oversharing risks. Nice to have: Previous customer-facing technical consulting experience. Exposure to AvePoint tools such as Opus, Backup, Cloud Governance, Policies and Insights and Fly. Experience using Microsoft 365 migration tools such as ShareGate and AvePoint Fly. Knowledge of Microsoft 365 backup and archiving solutions. Experience with modern DevOps tools and practices. Experience developing custom solutions using SharePoint Framework (SPFx), React, JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Knowledge of records-management regulations and compliance requirements. Basic experience building Copilot Studio agents, including configuring knowledge sources and instructions and testing responses. A tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline. ITIL certification. Technical writing or presentation training. Why join us here at Datacom? Datacom is one of Australia and New Zealand’s largest suppliers of Information Technology professional services. We have managed to maintain a dynamic, agile, small business feel that is often diluted in larger organisations of our size. It's our people that give Datacom its unique culture and energy that you can feel from the moment you meet with us. We care about our people and provide a range of perks such as social events, chill-out spaces, remote working, flexi-hours and professional development courses to name a few. You’ll have the opportunity to learn, develop your career, connect and bring your true self to work. You will be recognised and valued for your contributions and be able to do your work in a collegial, flat-structured environment. We operate at the forefront of technology to help Australia and New Zealand’s largest enterprise organisations explore possibilities and solve their greatest challenges, so you will never run out of interesting new challenges and opportunities. We want Datacom to be an inclusive and welcoming workplace for everyone and take pride in the steps we have taken and continue to take to make our environment fun and friendly, and our people feel supported.

review_candidates.title: Senior Cockroach Database Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description: At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes our commitment to being an inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognizing and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture with specific requirements for office-based attendance and which allows for an appropriate level of flexibility for our teammates and businesses based on role-specific considerations. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! Job Description: This job is responsible for leading the most complex technical designs that enable business strategies in accordance with architectural governance, standards and policies. Key responsibilities include facilitating deployment of the most complex technical solutions by developing templates, playbooks and automation used during implementation. Job expectations include consistently looking for opportunities to improve the reliability and efficiency of implementing the services, and influencing a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. We are seeking a highly experienced Senior CockroachDB Engineer to lead the design, engineering, build automation Bank's CockroachDB Database-as-a-Service (DBaaS) platform. This individual will be responsible for building a secure, scalable, highly available, and automated database platform on the Bank's internal infrastructure while establishing engineering standards and best practices for enterprise-wide adoption. Responsibilities: Serves as a consultant on a broad range of technologies, platforms, and vendor offerings to drive targeted business outcomes Develops software solutions to address manual and repeatable work or inefficient processes and contributes to the technology strategy for end-to-end engineering solutions and provides feedback to the architecture teams Translates business requirements into technical definitions, reference models, blueprints, and playbooks for deployment in compliance with architecture standards and policies Participates in various steering committees for technical and infrastructure service domains Leads the evaluation of reference models, blueprints and playbooks to ensure they are fit for purpose Mentors and guides team members to ensure system design technology solutions comply with enterprise system design and engineering standards Creates an inclusive and healthy working environment and help to resolve organizational impediments/blockers Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of the CockroachDB DBaaS platform deployed within the Bank's internal infrastructure. Build automation and self-service capabilities that enable rapid, standardized provisioning of CockroachDB clusters. Design and implement high availability (active-active), fault-tolerant, and multi-region database architectures. Establish engineering standards, reference architectures, operational procedures, and best practices for secure, scalable, and compliant CockroachDB deployments. Drive platform reliability and operational excellence through monitoring, observability, performance tuning, capacity planning, failover automation, backup, and disaster recovery solutions. Define and implement lifecycle management processes for cluster provisioning, upgrades, patching, scaling, and decommissioning. Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for CockroachDB related initiatives . Evaluate emerging technologies and continuously improve the platform architecture, automation, and operational model. Required Qualifications: Extensive hands-on experience with CockroachDB on Linux platforms. Strong expertise with Ansible automation frameworks. Proven experience designing and operating large-scale distributed database platforms in enterprise environments. Be able to design and implement end-to-end distributed database architectures using CockroachDB with a focus on: High Availability (HA) Fault Tolerance Multi-Region Deployments Active-Active Configurations Develop automation solutions for: VM-based provisioning Cluster deployment and configuration Lifecycle management Version upgrades and patching Horizontal and vertical scaling Implement automated monitoring, alerting, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery capabilities for CockroachDB environments. Strong expertise in Ansible playbooks, roles, and automation frameworks. Implement enterprise-grade security controls, including: TLS encryption Certificate lifecycle management Vault integration Key Management as a Service (KMaaS) integration Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, including: Consensus protocols Replication Quorum Failover and recovery mechanisms Experience integrating database automation with CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Bitbucket, GitHub, or similar platforms. Ability to define engineering standards, operational best practices, reference architectures, and governance models for enterprise database platforms. Desired Qualifications: Experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices is a plus Experience with deploying CockroachDB on AWS public cloud is a plus Skills: Adaptability Business Acumen Production Support Solution Design Stakeholder Management Automation Influence Innovative Thinking Solution Delivery Process Technical Strategy Development MS SQL Server Terraform Ansible Shift: 1st shift (United States of America) Hours Per Week: 40

review_candidates.description: Job Description The Director, Data Center On-Site Power Delivery is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of on-site power infrastructure supporting OCI’s data center campuses, including utility interconnections, substations, generation, energy storage, fuel-cell power solutions, and associated electrical distribution and controls. The role will lead the development and execution of EPC contracting strategies for major power infrastructure and will oversee EPC partners from procurement and contract award through engineering, equipment procurement, construction, commissioning, energization, and final turnover. The Director will also lead the deployment and integration of fuel-cell systemsand other on-site generation technologies where applicable, ensuring these solutions are properly integrated into the campus electrical architecture, utility strategy, operating model, and commissioning plan. This leader will work closely with Energy, Electrical Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, Procurement, Finance , Legal, and external utilities, EPC contractors, OEMs, and technology providers to deliver safe, reliable, scalable power infrastructure aligned with OCI’s cloud and AI capacity roadmap. Responsibilities EPC Contracting & Commercial Leadership Develop and execute EPC contracting strategies for major electrical and on-site power infrastructure projects. Lead EPC procurement activities, including development of scopes of work, technical requirements, commercial evaluation, bid processes, negotiations, and contractor selection. Establish appropriate risk allocation across Oracle, EPC contractors, equipment manufacturers, utilities, and specialty subcontractors. Manage EPC contracts through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, energization, and closeout. Oversee EPC contractor performance against schedule, budget, technical requirements, quality, safety, and contractual commitments. Review and negotiate change orders, claims, allowances, contingencies, schedule impacts, and commercial settlements. Establish governance and reporting mechanisms that provide senior leadership with clear visibility into EPC cost, schedule, risk, and performance. Partner with Legal, Procurement, Finance, and Engineering to ensure EPC agreements support OCI’s long-term delivery and operational objectives. Develop repeatable EPC delivery models that can be scaled across multiple data center campuses and regions. On-Site Generation & Fuel Cells Lead the delivery strategy for on-site power generation, including fuel-cell-based generation and other distributed energy solutions. Provide executive oversight for the deployment of fuel-cell systems supporting OCI data center capacity where applicable. Coordinate with OEM and other technology providers with electrical engineering, EPC, utility, construction, commissioning, and operations teams. Ensure fuel-cell systems are appropriately integrated with utility services, medium- and high-voltage infrastructure, switchgear, protection systems, controls, monitoring, and data center electrical distribution. Oversee technical and commercial interfaces between Oracle, Fuel Cell providers, EPC contractors, utilities, and equipment suppliers. Establish deployment standards, delivery schedules, acceptance requirements, and operational readiness criteria for fuel-cell installations. Manage site-specific challenges associated with fuel supply, interconnection, permitting, equipment delivery, installation, testing, commissioning, and long-term maintainability. Ensure fuel-cell systems are fully tested, commissioned, documented, and integrated into the overall campus operating model before operational handover. Evaluate opportunities to standardize and scale fuel-cell deployment across OCI’s expanding data center portfolio. Support business-case development and capacity planning for on-site generation solutions supporting accelerated AI and cloud infrastructure growth. Required Qualifications Add these requirements: Demonstrated experience developing and managing EPC contracts for large-scale electrical, power generation, utility, or infrastructure projects. Proven experience managing EPC contractors through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational turnover. Strong understanding of commercial risk allocation, change management, claims, contracting strategy, and EPC delivery models. Experience with distributed generation, fuel cells, microgrids, energy storage, or other on-site power generation technologies. Experience managing complex interfaces between utilities, EPC contractors, OEMs, technology providers, and data center construction teams. Preferred Qualifications Direct experience with fuel-cell deployments or comparable fuel-cell power generation systems. Experience integrating on-site generation into hyperscale data center electrical architectures. Experience developing multi-campus deployment strategies for distributed energy resources. Experience with utility-scale or behind-the-meter power generation programs. Experience negotiating and administering large, technically complex EPC agreements.
